title: Passive Voice, Relative Pronoun, and Conjunction — Level 10 — Final challenge

tags.kisi-kisi: Passive Voice, Relative Pronoun, and Conjunction

items.prompt: "The letter was wrote by my sister last night." Which part is kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Passive memakai V3: was written.

items.prompt: "The student which won the speech contest comes from Sumenep." Which part is kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Untuk orang pakai who: the student who won.

items.prompt: Choose the correct passive sentence about the bridge lights.

visual.text: The lights on the bridge are being repaired now.

choices.say: The lights on the bridge are being repaired now.

visual.text: The lights on the bridge are repairing now.

choices.say: The lights on the bridge are repairing now.

visual.text: The lights on the bridge is being repaired now.

choices.say: The lights on the bridge is being repaired now.

visual.text: The lights on the bridge are been repaired now.

choices.say: The lights on the bridge are been repaired now.

items.reteach: Passive present continuous: are + being + V3 (subjek jamak: are).

items.prompt: "Neither Raka nor his friends was invited to the party." Which part is kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Kata kerja ikut subjek terdekat (his friends = jamak): were invited.

items.prompt: "Although it was late, but we continued our journey." Which part is kurang tepat?
items.reteach: "Although" tidak dipasangkan dengan "but" dalam satu kalimat.

items.prompt: Choose the correct sentence using "whose".

visual.text: The farmer whose cows won the prize lives in Madura.

choices.say: The farmer whose cows won the prize lives in Madura.

visual.text: The farmer who's cows won the prize lives in Madura.

choices.say: The farmer who's cows won the prize lives in Madura.

visual.text: The farmer whom cows won the prize lives in Madura.

choices.say: The farmer whom cows won the prize lives in Madura.

visual.text: The farmer which cows won the prize lives in Madura.

choices.say: The farmer which cows won the prize lives in Madura.

items.reteach: whose = milik; who's = who is.

items.prompt: "English is speaking in many countries around the world." Which part is kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Bahasa "dituturkan", jadi passive: is spoken.

items.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with "not only … but also".

visual.text: She not only sings well but also plays the piano.

choices.say: She not only sings well but also plays the piano.

visual.text: She not only sings well but also play the piano.

choices.say: She not only sings well but also play the piano.

visual.text: She not only sings well and also plays the piano.

choices.say: She not only sings well and also plays the piano.

visual.text: She not only sing well but also plays the piano.

choices.say: She not only sing well but also plays the piano.

items.reteach: Pasangan: not only … but also, dengan bentuk kata kerja yang sejajar.

items.prompt: "The hotel where we stayed in was near Alun-Alun Batu." Which part is kurang tepat?
items.reteach: "where" sudah berarti "di tempat itu", jadi "in" tidak perlu.

items.prompt: "My bag has been took to the lost-and-found office." Which part is kurang tepat?
items.reteach: take – took – taken: has been taken.

items.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about the flooded road.

visual.text: The road was flooded; therefore, the bus was late.

choices.say: The road was flooded; therefore, the bus was late.

visual.text: The road was flooded; because, the bus was late.

choices.say: The road was flooded; because, the bus was late.

visual.text: The road was flooded; therefore the bus is late yesterday.

choices.say: The road was flooded; therefore the bus is late yesterday.

visual.text: Therefore the road was flooded, the bus was late.

choices.say: Therefore the road was flooded, the bus was late.

items.reteach: therefore memperkenalkan akibat, biasanya setelah titik koma atau titik.

items.prompt: "The winners will announced on the school website tomorrow." Which part is kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Passive future: will be announced.

items.prompt: "Either you or your brother have to clean the room." Which part is kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Kata kerja ikut subjek terdekat (your brother = tunggal): has to.

items.prompt: Read the pool notice. Why can't students use the swimming pool today?

stimulus.text: NOTICE: The swimming pool is being cleaned today. It will be reopened on Thursday. All lockers must be emptied by Wednesday afternoon. (Sports Office, SMPN 2 Batu)

visual.text: It is closed for a race.

choices.say: It is closed for a race.

items.reteach: "is being cleaned" = sedang dibersihkan.

items.prompt: Read the pool notice. What must students do by Wednesday afternoon?

stimulus.text: NOTICE: The swimming pool is being cleaned today. It will be reopened on Thursday. All lockers must be emptied by Wednesday afternoon. (Sports Office, SMPN 2 Batu)

items.reteach: "All lockers must be emptied by Wednesday afternoon."

items.prompt: Read the pool notice. Who wrote it?

stimulus.text: NOTICE: The swimming pool is being cleaned today. It will be reopened on Thursday. All lockers must be emptied by Wednesday afternoon. (Sports Office, SMPN 2 Batu)

items.reteach: Penulis notice ada di bagian akhir: Sports Office.

items.prompt: Read the text about the craftsman. Whose masks are sold in Malang?

stimulus.text: Pak Sanusi is a craftsman whose wooden masks are sold in Malang. The workshop where he works is next to his house. Visitors who come on Sundays can watch him carve.

items.reteach: "a craftsman whose wooden masks are sold in Malang" = topeng milik Pak Sanusi.

items.prompt: Read the text about the craftsman. In the text, "where" refers to …

stimulus.text: Pak Sanusi is a craftsman whose wooden masks are sold in Malang. The workshop where he works is next to his house. Visitors who come on Sundays can watch him carve.

items.reteach: "The workshop where he works" — where merujuk ke workshop.

items.prompt: Read the text about the craftsman. Who can watch Pak Sanusi carve?

stimulus.text: Pak Sanusi is a craftsman whose wooden masks are sold in Malang. The workshop where he works is next to his house. Visitors who come on Sundays can watch him carve.

items.reteach: "Visitors who come on Sundays can watch him carve."

items.prompt: Read the table of school events. Which statement about the art show is true?

visual.text: The art show was held on 12 May.

choices.say: The art show was held on 12 May.

visual.text: The art show was postponed to June.

choices.say: The art show was postponed to June.

visual.text: The art show will be held on 5 May.

choices.say: The art show will be held on 5 May.

items.reteach: Status art show = cancelled.

items.prompt: Read the table of school events. Which sentence about the book week is correct?

visual.text: The book week has been postponed to June.

choices.say: The book week has been postponed to June.

visual.text: The book week was held on 20 May.

choices.say: The book week was held on 20 May.

visual.text: The book week has been cancelled.

choices.say: The book week has been cancelled.

visual.text: The book week was held on 5 May.

choices.say: The book week was held on 5 May.

items.reteach: Status book week = postponed to June (ditunda).

items.prompt: Read the table of school events. Which event was held as planned in May?
items.reteach: Hanya science fair yang berstatus "held".

items.prompt: Read the text about Ijen. Why do most hikers start at about 1 a.m.?

stimulus.text: Ijen is famous for its blue fire. However, the fire can only be seen in the dark before dawn. Therefore, most hikers start at about 1 a.m., although the path is steep and cold.

visual.text: because the blue fire can only be seen before dawn

choices.say: because the blue fire can only be seen before dawn

visual.text: because it is warm at night

choices.say: because it is warm at night

visual.text: because the crater closes at noon

choices.say: because the crater closes at noon

items.reteach: "However, the fire can only be seen … before dawn. Therefore, most hikers start at about 1 a.m."

items.prompt: Read the text about Ijen. Which linking word in the text introduces a result?

stimulus.text: Ijen is famous for its blue fire. However, the fire can only be seen in the dark before dawn. Therefore, most hikers start at about 1 a.m., although the path is steep and cold.

items.reteach: Therefore = oleh karena itu (akibat).

items.prompt: Read the text about Ijen. What does "although the path is steep and cold" tell us?

stimulus.text: Ijen is famous for its blue fire. However, the fire can only be seen in the dark before dawn. Therefore, most hikers start at about 1 a.m., although the path is steep and cold.

visual.text: Hikers still go even though the path is difficult.

choices.say: Hikers still go even though the path is difficult.

visual.text: Hikers stay home because of the path.

choices.say: Hikers stay home because of the path.

visual.text: The path is easy and warm.

choices.say: The path is easy and warm.

visual.text: The blue fire is on the path.

choices.say: The blue fire is on the path.

items.reteach: although = meskipun: tetap mendaki walau jalannya sulit.

items.prompt: A: "Who is that boy?" B: "He's the student ___ painting won first prize."
items.reteach: whose + kata benda (painting) = lukisan miliknya.

items.prompt: A: "Is the hall ready for the graduation?" B: "Almost. The chairs ___ right now."
items.reteach: Passive present continuous: are being + V3.

items.prompt: A: "Shall we go to Jatim Park tomorrow?" B: "Sure, ___ it rains. If it rains, we'll stay home."
items.reteach: unless = kecuali jika.

items.prompt: A: "Do you know the place ___ they sell the best rawon?" B: "Yes, near Tunjungan Street."
items.reteach: Tempat + klausa lengkap: where.

items.prompt: A: "Did you enjoy the school trip?" B: "Yes, ___ the weather was bad, we had a lot of fun."
items.reteach: Pertentangan (cuaca buruk tetapi senang): although.

items.prompt: A: "Can I use the computer lab?" B: "Sorry, it ___ by Class 9A at the moment."
items.reteach: "at the moment" + passive: is being + V3.

items.prompt: A: "Which drink do you want, tea or coffee?" B: "___. I only drink water."
items.reteach: Neither = tidak keduanya.

items.prompt: A: "Why is the shop closed?" B: "The owner is sick; ___, the shop is closed today."
items.reteach: Akibat: therefore.

items.prompt: Buyer: "Who made these batik shirts?" Seller: "They ___ by local women in Pamekasan last month."
items.reteach: Passive simple past (last month): were + V3.

items.prompt: A: "Do you remember 2022?" B: "Of course. It was the year ___ we moved to Malang."
items.reteach: Waktu (the year) + klausa: when.

items.prompt: A: "Is Dimas good at sport?" B: "Yes, he plays ___ football ___ badminton very well."
items.reteach: both … and = dua-duanya.

items.prompt: Teacher: "Has the homework been checked?" Student: "Yes, Ma'am. It ___ by Pak Budi this morning."
items.reteach: Passive simple past: was + V3.

items.prompt: A: "Do you know the woman ___ Pak Hadi is talking to?" B: "Yes, she's our new principal."
items.reteach: whom = orang sebagai objek (talking to her).

items.prompt: Change into passive: "The school will hold the art festival next month."

items.prompt: Combine with "who": "The girl is my neighbour. She sang at the ceremony."

items.prompt: Combine with "neither … nor": "Raka doesn't like durian. Sinta doesn't like durian either."

visual.text: Neither Raka nor Sinta likes durian.

choices.say: Neither Raka nor Sinta likes durian.

visual.text: Neither Raka or Sinta likes durian.

items.prompt: Arrange the words: being / the / is / road / main / widened

visual.text: The main road is being widened.

choices.say: The main road is being widened.

visual.text: The main road being is widened.

choices.say: The main road being is widened.

visual.text: The road main is being widened.

choices.say: The road main is being widened.

visual.text: The main road is widened being.

choices.say: The main road is widened being.

items.reteach: Pola: subject + is + being + V3.

items.prompt: Arrange the words: where / the / is / this / house / born / was / I

visual.text: This is the house where I was born.

choices.say: This is the house where I was born.

visual.text: This is the house I where was born.

choices.say: This is the house I where was born.

visual.text: This is where the house I was born.

choices.say: This is where the house I was born.

visual.text: This the house is where I was born.

choices.say: This the house is where I was born.

items.reteach: Pola: This is + the house + where + subject + verb.

items.prompt: Change the passive sentence into active: "The cake was baked by Grandma."

visual.text: Grandma has been baked the cake.

choices.say: Grandma has been baked the cake.

items.reteach: was baked (simple past passive) → baked (simple past active).

items.prompt: Combine with "not only … but also": "Ayu speaks Javanese. She also speaks Madurese."

visual.text: Ayu speaks not only Javanese but also Madurese.

choices.say: Ayu speaks not only Javanese but also Madurese.

visual.text: Ayu speaks not only Javanese but Madurese also too.

choices.say: Ayu speaks not only Javanese but Madurese also too.

visual.text: Ayu not only speaks Javanese but also speak Madurese.

choices.say: Ayu not only speaks Javanese but also speak Madurese.

visual.text: Ayu speaks not only Javanese and also Madurese.

choices.say: Ayu speaks not only Javanese and also Madurese.

items.reteach: Pasangan: not only … but also, dengan bentuk yang sejajar.

items.prompt: Odd one out: who, which, whose, however
items.reteach: who, which, whose = relative pronoun; however = kata penghubung (contrast).

items.prompt: Analogy: "who" is to a person as "where" is to a ___.
items.reteach: who → orang; where → tempat.

items.prompt: Analogy: although : contrast = because : ___
items.reteach: although = pertentangan; because = alasan/sebab.

items.prompt: Riddle: I offer one choice out of two, and my partner is always "or". Who am I?
items.reteach: either … or = pilih satu dari dua.

items.prompt: Code: A = active, P = passive. "The vase was broken. Dimas fixed it. It is now kept in a box." Which code fits the three sentences in order?
items.reteach: was broken (P), fixed (A), is kept (P).

items.prompt: Odd one out: which sentence is NOT passive?

visual.text: The bell was rung by the guard.

choices.say: The bell was rung by the guard.

items.reteach: "rang" adalah active simple past; tiga lainnya be + V3.

items.prompt: Logic: Raka said, "The bag is either in the car or in the classroom." The bag is not in the car. Where is the bag?
items.reteach: either … or = satu dari dua tempat; bukan di mobil, berarti di kelas.

items.prompt: Logic: "Neither Ayu nor Lina brought a hat. Both Lina and Rina brought umbrellas." Who certainly brought an umbrella but no hat?
items.reteach: Lina tidak membawa topi (neither … nor) dan membawa payung (both … and). Topi Rina tidak diketahui.

items.prompt: Riddle: "I am a thing which has keys but cannot open any door. People who type use me." What am I?
items.reteach: keyboard punya "keys" (tombol) untuk mengetik.

items.prompt: Riddle: "I sound exactly like who's, but I mean milik siapa." Which word am I?
items.reteach: whose (milik) dan who's (who is) diucapkan sama.

items.prompt: Count the passive verbs: "The library was built in 1990. It has been renovated twice. Students love it. New books are added every month."
items.reteach: was built, has been renovated, are added = 3; "love" adalah active.

items.prompt: Pattern: active "write" → passive "is written"; active "drive" → passive ___
items.reteach: drive – drove – driven, jadi passive: is driven.

items.prompt: Odd one out: so, therefore, as a result, unless
items.reteach: so, therefore, as a result = akibat; unless = syarat (kecuali jika).
